newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope gives cardinals copy of his new book.
newsitem.headline: Pope gives cardinals copy of his new book.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Sunday gave cardinals attending a celebration of his 50 years as a priest a copy of his new autobiography, "Gift and Mystery".
He also posed under a statue of Christ for a souvenir photograph with more than 1,500 other Roman Catholic priests ordained the same year.

The 76-year-old Pope, who became a priest in his native Poland on November 1, 1946, celebrated a solemn mass in St Peter's Basilica on Sunday with more than 1,500 priests and some 200 cardinals and bishops from around the world.
The atmosphere then turned festive as a huge hot-air balloon festooned with messages rose into the sky and music played for more than 50,000 faithful packed into St Peter's square.
The Pontiff, recovering from an operation last month to remove his appendix, hosted lunches for the visiting clergy.
The new book of memoirs and musings, originally written in Polish, contains relections on the priesthood and photographs.
His 1995 book, "Crossing the Threshold of Hope", became an international best-seller.
